title: like an old friend ~
body: This app shows up as 90% of my screen time on a daily basis. Despite being an aspiring writer, I use it more than Word (AI bs has taken over that app) and Google Docs. I save all my notes to ICloud, in case of glitches. Unfortunately, after writing a 20 A4 page note (not even halfway through a narrative) it crashed, causing that specific note to be completely unavailable. I attempted to retrieve it through the web version, but that crashed as well. Luckily, I had previously sent my writing to a friend for peer review. Only the last three pages were written after that, so I was able to recover the rest of my story with minimal loss. Still, it put me through a considerable amount of stress and panic-crying. I suppose I should be grateful that Notes had even lasted that long. The app was definitely not built for long, rambling paragraphs of prose. I have recently begun writing a new story, using one note for every chapter in order to prevent the incident from happening again. The possibility of losing all my work haunts me still. But the fact that I still use it consistently says a lot about Notes’ effectiveness. Or perhaps it is only nostalgia and a strange, vague sentiment that brings me here, typing a review instead of my story, sitting in a writer’s block that has gripped me for weeks.

I have switched back to my paid Goodnotes app and subscription as it still has the edge over Apple Notes for now.  I would love to see Apple really take Notes to another level soon and I’d happily move back to it,

title: Pros, Cons, Wishes, Epiphany
body:
Mobile user.

Pros.

I find Notes reasonably good and reliable.
Searching for tags or text is good, but could be better
Cons.

No Undelete icon.  It would seem that some users are not aware that giving your mobile a few quicks shakes laterally will bring up an ‘Undo Typing’ option to recover that important chunk of text which was inadvertently deleted. But why hide it?  It’s not even mentioned in the app description.  **Even easier, just add an icon. There is enough space, and it is *easy to add an icon for functionality which is *already there*, but hidden.
Description says: “Try typing >> for a shortcut to add links while writing in your note.”  I typed >>, and all I got was >>. Where is this mysterious ‘add links’?

Wish List:

I find tags very useful, but when searching through Notes for one  tag/word, *but there are times I want to search for two or more words, and the search will return Notes for either word(s) but *not mutually inclusive.   eg., I wish to search for a particular Note using the words ‘earth’, ‘saturn’, ‘gravity’, because I am an astronomy/space/physics person, the search result will every Note with earth, every Note with saturn, *and every Note with gravity.  I may have 00’s of Notes where *any of those words*, but only 1 with those exact three words, resulting in manually going through each Note until I find the *only entry* which has those 3 words.  Polish the search, for example, to earth+saturn+gravity. Only then will I find the 1 Note out of 00’s.
Search *within an open Note.  I have had situations where I need to search within the current Note for multiple occurrences of a word, symbol, or character.
Locked Notes are great, so why not include fingerprint lock on the app?

Epiphany:

Why don’t Apple ever acknowledge reviews?

Why not include some of the basic features of other ‘note apps’ available?

Answer: because Notes are included for free, therefor there are no monetary gains to be had ~ just tweak it occasionally.

But why❓

Because if people get sick of Notes and switch to another app that app may be a paid app, and regardless of the price Apple gets a %.

It doesn’t sound like much, but I would love just $1 from everything someone bought a paid app.

title: Buggy
body:
I’ve used Notes for years, and have a lot of recipes, checklists etc saved in it.

But for the past nine months or so, half the time when I open up a note, the text is the same colour as the background.

Highlighting the text (which sometimes works in other apps) doesn’t make any difference, nor is there a pattern to whether it’s more common in daylight mode or night mode. Shutting down and restarting doesn’t do the trick either.

I usually end up trying again a day later, which generally works. If it’s something urgent, I have to select the text then paste it into another app, usually an email.

But seriously guys, this app has one job … can we try and get it right?
